description: Reference greenfield TDD run for tasks/users-api.task.yaml on the express-zod scaffold: plan, write the users test, observe red, mount the router, implement routes, schemas and store, observe green, check standards, finish.

turns.text: Plan first, then look at the scaffold's route registry and problem helpers.

steps: Write test/users.test.ts with supertest against createApp() covering every behaviour (201 + Location, role default, 409 duplicate email, 422 invalid body, 400 malformed JSON, Idempotency-Key replay and reuse, cursor pagination with default 20 and max 100, 404 unknown id, PATCH, DELETE 204)
Run the test and observe it fail (routes do not exist yet)
Implement src/routes/users.ts with every request part parsed by Zod and every 2xx body parsed by a schema
Add src/schemas/user.ts (Zod schemas, types via z.infer) and src/store/users.ts (in-memory, unique email -> conflict)
Run the tests until green, then check_standards, then finish

turns.text: Write the behaviour tests before any source.
Run the new test to observe red.
Red observed. Mount the users router (src/routes/index.ts is reached from the test through src/app.ts).
Add the Zod schemas and the store the routes import.

input.summary: Users API: list (cursor-paginated, limit default 20, max 100), get, create (201 + Location, Idempotency-Key, 409 on duplicate email), update (PATCH, 409 on email clash), delete (204). Every request part and 2xx body is parsed by Zod; every error is application/problem+json.
